settings.label: Logo
settings.info: Used by the header and footer when those sections have no logo of their own. Leave empty to use the packaged brand logo assets.

settings.label: Accent colour
settings.info: Drives --accent: filled buttons, active nav, icons, headline accent.

settings.label: Bright accent colour
settings.info: Drives --accent-bright: focus rings, small stat numbers, promo links.

settings.label: Free download URL
settings.info: Every Download for Free button on the storefront points here.

settings.label: Before and after video (optional)
settings.info: The clip already plays on the home page as an animated image, so this is optional. For full video quality, upload the MP4 under Settings then Files, copy its URL and paste it here.

settings.content: These override the home page title and description from Online Store then Preferences. Leave blank to use Preferences instead. Do not add the store name to the title, the theme appends it.

settings.label: Home page title
settings.info: Aim for 48 characters or fewer. The theme adds " | MIZTWEAKZ" after it, and Google cuts the result around 60.
settings.default: Low FPS on a Good PC? Fix It Without New Hardware

settings.label: Home page meta description
settings.info: Aim for 150 to 160 characters. Google truncates past that.
settings.default: Your PC is fast but your games do not feel like it. 525 tested Windows tweaks that cut input delay and steady your frames. Free app, fully reversible.

settings.content: The video shown on /pages/install, the page a visitor lands on after clicking any download button. Shopify will not host an .mp4 as a theme file, so upload it under Content then Files and paste its URL here.

settings.label: Install video URL
settings.info: The direct .mp4 link from Content then Files. Leave blank to hide the player and show only the written steps.
